name: Pharmaceutical Heist Alibi Verification
task:
Please complete the following four-stage alibi verification task in order.

=== Stage 1: Suspect Timeline Extraction ===
Controlled substances were stolen from MedPharm's secure storage at 2:45am. Three night-shift workers:
- Worker A (Dr. Nash): Pharmacist. Claims he was filling prescriptions in the main pharmacy. Computer log shows activity at 2:00am, 2:30am, and 3:15am. Gap from 2:30am-3:15am.
- Worker B (Olivia): Nurse. Claims she was doing rounds on the 3rd floor. Floor access log shows 2:00am, 2:25am, 3:00am. The storage room is on the 2nd floor.
- Worker C (Peter): Orderly. Claims he was in the cafeteria on break. Cafeteria camera shows him from 2:15am-2:40am, then he leaves toward the elevator.
The storage room requires both a keycard and a fingerprint. The log shows Dr. Nash's card and fingerprint at 2:44am. The theft took 5 minutes. Extract timelines.

=== Stage 2: Evidence Cross-Comparison ===
Cross-reference against:
- Storage room camera: disabled at 2:43am
- Elevator log: elevator used at 2:40am (2nd floor), 2:50am (2nd floor)
- Stairwell: motion sensor triggered at 2:42am (2nd floor)
- Inventory system: drugs marked as removed at 2:46am
- Witness: Olivia says she saw Peter on the 2nd floor at 2:38am

=== Stage 3: Contradiction Resolution ===
Resolve with priority: access logs > inventory > elevator > camera > witness > suspect statements.

=== Stage 4: Final Determination ===
Identify the thief. Determine if credentials were stolen or coerced. Note any accomplice scenarios.

subtasks.name: Timeline contradiction resolution and consistency adjustment
